zh.title: 德執法單位於萊比錫機場（LEJ）附近發現第三架無人機與炸藥
zh.summary: 德國當局於萊比錫機場附近發現第3架無人機與炸藥；檢警已展開調查
body: 德國執法當局於萊比錫/哈雷機場西側的卡貝爾斯克塔爾（Kabelsketal）農田發現第3架無人機，並於次日於同一地點發現約50公克的黑索金（hexogen）炸藥。相關設備與炸藥已由鑑識人員進行分析。
此項發現距首起事件約10天。8月4日，萊比錫/哈雷機場（HAJ）附近曾發現一架載有炸藥的無人機，位置接近停放的安托諾夫航空（Antonov Airlines）An-124貨機。隨後在機場關閉期間，第2架無人機於轉降過程中撞擊一架DHL貨機，造成該貨機尾翼受損並降落於漢諾威機場。
此外，執法人員亦於8月11日在機場周邊發現馬達與旋翼等無人機零組件。德國聯邦刑事警察局（BKA）已受聯邦總檢察長羅梅爾（Jens Rommel）委託對全案展開調查。

en.title: Third Drone and Explosives Discovered Near Leipzig Airport (LEJ)
en.summary: German authorities found a third drone and explosives near Leipzig Airport; federal police are investigating the incident.
body: German authorities discovered a third unmanned aerial vehicle in a field in Kabelsketal, west of Leipzig/Halle Airport , on August 14, 2026. Forensic investigators subsequently located approximately 50 grams of hexogen explosive at the same site the following day.

The discovery follows earlier incidents near the airport. On August 4, 2026, an explosive-laden drone was found near a parked Antonov Airlines An-124. Shortly after, a second drone struck a DHL cargo aircraft following the temporary closure of the airport, causing tail section damage prior to its diversion landing at Hanover Airport (HAJ)                      .

Investigators also recovered additional drone components, including a motor and rotor, near the airport on August 11, 2026. The Federal Criminal Police Office is conducting an investigation into the incidents on behalf of Federal Prosecutor General Jens Rommel.

zh.title: 羅馬尼亞國防部統計：2026年無人機入侵領空達25起 接近2025年總數三倍
zh.summary: 羅馬尼亞國防部指出，2026年已錄得25起無人機入侵領空與47次戰機起飛監控。
body: 根據羅馬尼亞國防部截至2026年8月25日更新的事件儀表板統計，羅馬尼亞在2026年期間共記錄到25起未經授權的無人機侵入國家領空或領海事件。與2025年全年的9起相比，2026年的無人機入侵數量已接近前一年總數的三倍。
國防部統計資料同時顯示，2026年共發生47次執行空中警戒任務的戰機起飛監控空情狀況，高於2025年全年的21次。羅馬尼亞國防部特別說明，上述各項統計數據均定義為特定事件狀況的次數，而非計算個別飛機數量或執行出勤的架次。
根據AeroTime報導，羅馬尼亞軍方在2026年8月24日單日即執行兩次戰機緊急起飛。當地時間上午6時左右，雷達在鄰近卡胡爾的摩爾多瓦領空偵測到間歇信號，隨後出現在加拉茨縣的特爾古布茹爾上空。羅馬尼亞空軍隨即派遣兩架F-16戰鬥機與一架IAR-330 SOCAT直升機起飛，並向民眾發布RO-Alert警報訊息。軍方後續在弗朗恰縣奇烏斯列亞的一處民宅院內發現不含爆炸物的無人機組件。
同日晚間22時37分，雷達於蛇島西北方25公里處再次偵測到兩個空中目標朝羅馬尼亞國界移動。部署於米哈伊爾科格爾尼恰努第57空軍基地的西班牙空天軍兩架F/A-18大黃蜂戰鬥機緊急起飛監控狀況，國家軍事指揮中心並向圖爾恰縣北部發送警報。該目標於22時58分自雷達消失，烏克蘭一側隨後傳出爆炸聲，未偵測到侵入羅馬尼亞領空。
此項統計資料反映出該地區持續進行的防空警戒行動。羅馬尼亞空軍F-16飛行員曾於2026年7月24日至7月26日間擊落三架無人機；8月20日，一架F-16戰機在羅馬尼亞專屬經濟區內使用機砲對一艘海上無人艇開火。歷史紀錄顯示，該艘漂流的海上無人艇在獲准開火後被安全摧毀。

en.title: Romania Records 25 Drone Incursions in 2026, Nearly Tripling 2025 Total
en.summary: Romania recorded 25 drone incursions in 2026 as military jets launched 47 times to monitor air targets.
body: According to an incident dashboard maintained by the Ministry of National Defense of Romania (MApN) current as of August 25, 2026, Romania recorded 25 unauthorized drone incursions into its national airspace or territorial waters during 2026. This figure represents nearly triple the nine unauthorized drone incursions recorded across the whole of 2025.

The same defense ministry dashboard counted 47 situations in 2026 in which aircraft on air policing duty were launched to monitor the air situation, compared with 21 across 2025. The Ministry of National Defense defined each figure as a count of specific situations rather than counting individual aircraft or flight sorties.

The report detailed two fighter scramble operations taking place on August 24, 2026. Around 06:00 local time, radar detected intermittent signals over Moldovan airspace near Cahul, leading to the launch of two Romanian Air Force F-16 fighters and an IAR-330 SOCAT helicopter. A RO-Alert emergency cell broadcast message was sent to the population. Drone components carrying no explosive charge were later identified on a property at Ciuslea in Vrancea County, having crossed into national airspace from the direction of Moldova.

Later that evening at 22:37 on August 24, 2026, radar detected two air targets 25 kilometers northwest of Snake Island moving toward the Romanian border. Two Spanish Air and Space Force F/A-18 Hornet fighters deployed from the 57th Air Base at Mihail Kogalniceanu to monitor the situation, while a RO-Alert message was dispatched to northern Tulcea County. The contacts left radar at 22:58 with explosions reported on the Ukrainian side and no penetration of Romanian airspace detected.

The statistics follow earlier defense responses in the region. Romanian F-16 pilots previously downed three drones between July 24 and July 26, 2026, and on August 20, 2026, an F-16 opened fire with its cannon on a maritime drone inside Romania’s exclusive economic zone. Historical records show that the maritime drone was safely destroyed near the Neptun Alpha platform after fighters received authorization to fire.
